The Bluejays were led by eighth-year head coach [[Greg McDermott]] and played their home games at the [[CenturyLink Center Omaha]], as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 21–12, 10–8 in [[2017–18 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in a three-way tie for third place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2018 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] to [[2017–18 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 8 seed in the South Region. There the Bluejays lost in the first round to [[2017–18 Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball team|Kansas State]]. ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Bluejays]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 25–10, 10–8 in [[2016–17 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in a four-way tie for third place. In the [[2017 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they defeated [[2016–17 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]] and [[2016–17 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]] before losing to [[2016–17 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Villanova]] in the championship game. They received an at-large bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as a No. 6 seed in the Midwest region.
